stemMarkdown: A thief driving at 44 km/h gets a head start of 2.5 hours. A police car then sets off along the same road at 57 km/h. How many hours does the police car take to catch the thief? (Round to 4 decimal places.)
solutionMarkdown: In 2.5 hours the thief covers $44 \times 2.5 = 110.0$ km. The police close that gap at $57 - 44 = 13$ km/h, taking $\dfrac{110.0}{13} = 8.4615$ hours.
